text_translation: I am the wheat of God, and let me be ground by the teeth of the wild beasts, that I may be found the pure bread of Christ.
locus: Ignatius, Epistle to the Romans 4 (SHORTER/middle recension)

text_translation: Let that be deemed a proper Eucharist, which is [administered] either by the bishop, or by one to whom he has entrusted it. Wherever the bishop shall appear, there let the multitude [of the people] also be. Even as, wherever Jesus Christ is, there is the Catholic Church.
locus: Ignatius, Epistle to the Smyrnaeans 8 (SHORTER/middle recension)

text_translation: Eighty and six years have I served Him, and He never did me any injury: how then can I blaspheme my King and my Saviour?

And they who are well to do, and willing, give what each thinks fit. What is collected is deposited with the president, who succours the orphans and widows and those who, through sickness or any other cause, are in want. [He] takes care of those who are in bonds and the strangers sojourning among us.
First, thou shalt love God who made thee. Second, thy neighbour as thyself. And all things whatsoever thou wouldst should not occur to thee, thou also to another do not do.
locus: The Didache (Teaching of the Twelve Apostles) 1:2
